Definition: Malcam or Milcom, the national idol of the Ammonites
BiblicalUsage: Malcam, also called Milcom, was the abomination of the Ammonites, their national god. 1 Kings 11:5 says Solomon went after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites, and 1 Kings 11:33 says the people worshipped him and forsook God's ways, while 2 Kings 23:13 says Josiah defiled the high places Solomon had built for Milcom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Milcom is the warning in Solomon's story: the wisest king built a high place for a foreign god, and it took a reforming king to tear it down.
